LOCAL_ACADEMY.description: Files shipped inside this repository and expected to migrate with it.

ACADEMY_REPOSITORY.description: Intentional links into separate Khaemenes curriculum or school repositories.
ACADEMY_REPOSITORY.migrationRule: Preserve route identity; resolve to STOS-native repository after that repository is separately migrated and certified.

VERVE_SHARED.description: Canonical ecosystem services currently hosted by Verve N Veda.
VERVE_SHARED.migrationRule: Preserve during GitHub production; do not silently clone or fork without a separate STOS shared-service authority decision.

OPTIONAL_EXTERNAL.migrationRule: Must never become required for core Academy operation.

PAYMENT_EXTERNAL.migrationRule: Remain external unless separately replaced by an approved payment authority.

BROWSER_COMPATIBILITY_STORAGE.description: Browser-local continuity used by current GitHub deployment.
BROWSER_COMPATIBILITY_STORAGE.migrationRule: Preserve for live GitHub behavior; later map through an explicit storage adapter rather than deleting or relabeling as STOS storage.
